name: Gravity Wars
author: Boris (whyboris)
description: Artillery among the planets: aim, choose the power and let gravity bend the shot towards the other ship. Two players on one screen. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

descriptions.en: Artillery among the planets: aim, choose the power and let gravity bend the shot towards the other ship. Two players on one screen. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.
descriptions.it: Artiglieria tra i pianeti: mira, scegli la potenza e lascia che la gravità curvi il colpo verso l'altra astronave. Due giocatori sullo stesso schermo. Un gioco LÖVE sul motore Lua App.
